- **Notas:** Não aplicar automaticamente e não prometer melhoria.


### CPU-THROTTLE — CPU thermal/power throttling diagnosis

- **Categoria:** CPU / diagnostics

- **Implementação:** Ler sensores suportados via HWiNFO/LibreHardwareMonitor API or ETW; detectar thermal, PL1/PL2, PPT/TDC/EDC, effective clocks.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Somente leitura; corrigir causa

- **Benefício possível:** Evitar perda de clocks quando há superaquecimento/limite de potência; benefício pode ser alto se throttling existe.

- **Risco:** Baixo | **Evidência:** Alta para diagnóstico | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Sensores suportados, temperatura.

- **Rollback:** Sem alteração automática; corrigir cooling/power limit via OEM.

- **Como validar:** Before/after effective clocks and clocks reason flags.

- **Notas:** Não contornar proteções térmicas.


### PWR-SLEEP — Sleep timeout

- **Categoria:** Power / sleep

- **Implementação:** powercfg /change standby-timeout-ac N; consultar AC/DC antes; expor separadamente e alertar notebook.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Preferência do usuário; não é gaming FPS

- **Benefício possível:** Somente evita suspensão; não melhora jogo ativo.

- **Risco:** Baixo-médio | **Evidência:** Alta para comportamento, zero FPS | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Desktop/laptop and AC/DC aware.

- **Rollback:** Restaurar minute values exact.

- **Como validar:** Check standby settings.

- **Notas:** Nunca alterar DC sem confirmar bateria.


### PWR-HYBRID — Hybrid sleep

- **Categoria:** Power / sleep

- **Implementação:** powercfg SUB_SLEEP HYBRIDSLEEP index AC/DC when schema supports; UI preferred.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default

- **Benefício possível:** Altera recuperação de suspensão; sem FPS.

- **Risco:** Médio | **Evidência:** Sem ganho de gaming | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** S3 sleep available.

- **Rollback:** Reapply saved value.

- **Como validar:** Suspend/resume, power behavior.

- **Notas:** Não aplicar em todos notebooks.


### PWR-MODERN — Modern Standby (S0 low power idle)

- **Categoria:** Power / sleep

- **Implementação:** Somente ler `powercfg /a`; não prometer alternar S0/S3 via registry/Windows.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Padrão do fabricante

- **Benefício possível:** Sem FPS gain; mudança pode quebrar sleep/wake.

- **Risco:** Alto | **Evidência:** Sem evidência de FPS | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Laptop/platform firmware controls available?

- **Rollback:** No auto rollback; manual OEM path only.

- **Como validar:** powercfg /a, suspend/resume, battery drain.

- **Notas:** Não incluir toggle falso.


### PWR-DEVICE — Device power saving / USB selective suspend

- **Categoria:** Power / USB

- **Implementação:** Per-device Device Manager power management / powercfg SUB_USB USBSELECTIVE only when supported; use per device, not global by default.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Padrão; desativar só em device drop/wake issue

- **Benefício possível:** Pode resolver disconnects/wake latency; aumenta energia e não costuma melhorar polling normal.

- **Risco:** Médio | **Evidência:** Condicional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Specific USB device/reproducible disconnect.

- **Rollback:** Restore exact device property/power plan.

- **Como validar:** USB events, disconnect count, mouse polling stability.

- **Notas:** Laptop battery caution.


### PWR-PCIe — PCI Express Link State Power Management

- **Categoria:** Power / PCIe

- **Implementação:** powercfg SUB_PCIEXPRESS ASPM when exposed; test Off only for diagnosis; no blanket device power policy.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Balanced/default

- **Benefício possível:** Can avoid transitions in edge cases but usually small/no FPS effect.

- **Risco:** Médio | **Evidência:** Condicional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** PCIe platform and setting exposed.

- **Rollback:** Restore previous AC/DC index.

- **Como validar:** GPU clocks, sleep/wake, watt/temp and frametime.

- **Notas:** Off increases idle power/heat.


### PWR-DISKIDLE — Disk idle timeout / storage idle

- **Categoria:** Power / storage

- **Implementação:** powercfg SUB_DISK DISKIDLE and drive properties only after identify HDD vs SSD and AC/DC; do not disable SSD firmware power features blindly.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default; HDD-only scenario-specific test

- **Benefício possível:** May avoid wake-up delay from spinning HDD; does not improve steady-state FPS.

- **Risco:** Médio | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** HDD spin-down issue or game on HDD.

- **Rollback:** Restore exact timeout values.

- **Como validar:** Load times, disk response, power usage.

- **Notas:** Never claim SSD FPS gain.


### PWR-SLEEPSTUDY — Sleep Study

- **Categoria:** Power / diagnostics

- **Implementação:** Read-only diagnostics; no generic FPS setting; if EXM toggle disables diagnostic capture, expose as privacy/diagnostics not gaming.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Keep diagnostics available

- **Benefício possível:** No FPS expected.

- **Risco:** Médio | **Evidência:** Sem evidência | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Device with supported sleep study.

- **Rollback:** Re-enable diagnostics through original OS interface.

- **Como validar:** Sleep diagnostics intact.

- **Notas:** Do not suppress sleep diagnostics as gaming boost.


### MEM-PAGEFILE — Pagefile / virtual memory

- **Categoria:** Memory

- **Implementação:** Check pagefile with CIM/Win32_ComputerSystem and page file usage; leave System Managed by default; do not disable.

- **Padrão recomendado:** System managed

- **Benefício possível:** Prevents commit limit failures; can reduce crash risk. Pagefile sizing rarely improves FPS if memory isn't under pressure.

- **Risco:** Alto se desativar | **Evidência:** Oficial | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Windows and disk space.

- **Rollback:** Restore system-managed setting/reboot.

- **Como validar:** Committed bytes/limit, hard faults, crash logs, 1% lows.

- **Notas:** App may diagnose memory pressure but should not “clean RAM”.


### MEM-COMPRESSION — Memory compression

- **Categoria:** Memory

- **Implementação:** Read-only/system-managed; no registry toggle by default.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Windows default on managed systems

- **Benefício possível:** Can reduce paging pressure; disabling can increase storage I/O.

- **Risco:** Alto | **Evidência:** No universal gain | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Windows build.

- **Rollback:** Restore OS default via supported cmdlet if altered; no auto toggle.

- **Como validar:** Commit, hard faults, paging, CPU.

- **Notas:** Do not disable globally as gaming optimization.


### MEM-STANDBY — Standby list / RAM cleaner

- **Categoria:** Memory

- **Implementação:** Do not purge standby list automatically; measure available memory, commit, hard faults, standby list only for diagnosing pressure.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Keep cache

- **Benefício possível:** Purging can increase disk reads/recompile and stutters.

- **Risco:** Médio | **Evidência:** No performance benefit general | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** RAM pressure is measurable.

- **Rollback:** No state changes usually.

- **Como validar:** Disk I/O, hard faults, shader compilation, frametime.

- **Notas:** No timer-based cleaners.


### MEM-XMP — RAM profile status (read-only, no BIOS settings)

- **Categoria:** Memory / diagnostics

- **Implementação:** Use SMBIOS/CPU-Z-like readout only; in this app, no BIOS controls. Report channel/rate if reliable; never change firmware.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Read-only; guide to OEM manual separately

- **Benefício possível:** Can reveal RAM running at JEDEC instead of expected speed; changing requires firmware, excluded.

- **Risco:** Baixo | **Evidência:** Useful diagnosis | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** SMBIOS/driver support.

- **Rollback:** No changes through app.

- **Como validar:** Read frequency/channel and compare expected SKU.

- **Notas:** No BIOS UI or writes.


### MEM-DIAG-HISTORY — Diagnostic memory history logging

- **Categoria:** Memory / diagnostics

- **Implementação:** Use supported Windows diagnostic policy/UI if exact setting is documented; no guessed registry values.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Keep diagnostic history

- **Benefício possível:** Privacy/storage impact, not FPS.

- **Risco:** Médio | **Evidência:** No performance evidence | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Windows version/settings exact.

- **Rollback:** Restore original diagnostic settings.

- **Como validar:** Check event logs/diagnostics availability.

- **Notas:** Do not suppress crash/error diagnostics for FPS.


### MEM-RAM-ERROR — Suppress diagnostics on RAM errors

- **Categoria:** Memory / safety

- **Implementação:** Do not implement a one-click disable. Offer diagnostic explanation and open Windows Memory Diagnostic/Event Viewer.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Keep diagnostics enabled

### GPU-OC-UV — GPU undervolt/overclock

- **Padrão recomendado:** Stock baseline

- **Benefício possível:** Potentially higher sustained clocks/less throttling; instability/driver reset possible.

### GPU-THERMAL — GPU thermal/power diagnosis

- **Categoria:** GPU / diagnostics

- **Implementação:** Read GPU temperature/hotspot/memory temperature, clocks, power, utilization and PerfCap reason through supported monitoring API; recommend fan curve/case cooling, not safety bypass.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Read-only; maintain thermal protections

### GPU-DMA — Disable NVIDIA DMA remapping / disable security profile

### NET-BASELINE — Network baseline (ping/jitter/loss)

- **Categoria:** Network / diagnostics

- **Implementação:** Ping default gateway and user-selected stable endpoint; record idle and under parallel upload/download load; use multiple samples, don't rely on one ICMP result.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Read-only baseline

- **Benefício possível:** Identifies local vs internet/bufferbloat issues; not an optimization itself.

- **Risco:** Baixo | **Evidência:** High diagnostic value | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Network route and endpoint reachability.

- **Rollback:** No changes.

### NET-ETHERNET — Ethernet vs Wi-Fi / Wi-Fi signal

- **Categoria:** Network / physical

- **Implementação:** Detect adapter type, link speed, RSSI/channel where available; recommend cable or stronger/less congested band rather than registry tweaks.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Ethernet when practical

- **Benefício possível:** Often stabilizes jitter/loss; does not change ISP route.

- **Risco:** Baixo | **Evidência:** High conditional | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Adapter/network.

- **Rollback:** No settings to revert if just advice.

- **Como validar:** Latency under load, retransmissions, Wi-Fi signal/channel.

- **Notas:** No claims on ping without measurement.


### NET-TCP-AUTOTUNE — TCP receive window autotuning

- **Categoria:** Network / TCP

- **Implementação:** Read `netsh interface tcp show global`; keep autotuning normal unless diagnosis and Microsoft/vendor guidance justify a change.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Normal/default

- **Benefício possível:** Autotuning matters for TCP throughput on high-bandwidth/high-RTT paths; most game traffic is UDP, so often no in-game latency gain.

- **Risco:** High if disabled | **Evidência:** Official | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Windows TCP stack.

- **Rollback:** Restore `netsh interface tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal` if it was deliberately changed from default, after checking original.

- **Como validar:** TCP throughput, latency, loss; game-specific protocol.

- **Notas:** Do not switch to disabled as “low latency” preset.

- **Fontes:** [https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics)


### NET-RSS — Receive Side Scaling (RSS)

- **Categoria:** Network / NIC

- **Implementação:** `Get-NetAdapterRss`; `Enable-NetAdapterRss`/`Disable-NetAdapterRss` only if supported and original state recorded; do not force CPU mappings generically.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Enabled/default when supported

- **Benefício possível:** Distributes processing and can reduce CPU bottleneck; disabling can hurt throughput and CPU efficiency.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Official/conditional | **Modo:** `conditional`

- **Elegibilidade:** NIC driver supports RSS.

- **Rollback:** Restore exact Enabled/Disabled and any processor settings.

- **Notas:** Microsoft advises workload-specific tuning.

- **Fontes:** [https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics)


### NET-CHECKSUM — Checksum offloads

- **Categoria:** Network / NIC

- **Implementação:** Read `Get-NetAdapterChecksumOffload`; enable/restore driver-supported TCP/UDP/IP checksum offloads via cmdlets/UI.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Enabled/default

- **Benefício possível:** Usually reduces CPU cost; disabling can help only if broken driver/offload issue is demonstrated.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Official/conditional | **Modo:** `conditional`

- **Elegibilidade:** NIC and driver expose feature.

- **Rollback:** Restore original values per adapter.

- **Como validar:** CPU usage, packet errors, latency under traffic.

- **Notas:** Do not disable all offloads because of generic guides.

- **Fontes:** [https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics)


### NET-LSO — Large Send Offload (LSO)

- **Categoria:** Network / NIC

- **Implementação:** Read `Get-NetAdapterLso`; enable/restore supported LSO properties through cmdlets/UI.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Enabled/default

- **Benefício possível:** Typically improves throughput/CPU efficiency; on specific faulty drivers may be isolated in troubleshooting.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Official/conditional | **Modo:** `conditional`

- **Elegibilidade:** NIC supports LSO.

- **Rollback:** Restore original per send/receive path.

- **Como validar:** CPU, throughput, loss and app latency.

- **Notas:** Benchmark under real workload.

- **Fontes:** [https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics)


### NET-INTMOD — Interrupt moderation/coalescing

- **Categoria:** Network / NIC

- **Implementação:** Query advanced properties and allowed values via `Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty`; change only exact adapter property exposed by signed driver. Test Disabled vs Adaptive/Low; no global universal choice.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Driver default/Adaptive; try lower only for latency-sensitive test

- **Benefício possível:** Lower moderation may reduce packet processing delay but increases interrupts/CPU; under load may worsen performance.

- **Risco:** Medium-high | **Evidência:** Official tradeoff | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Como validar:** Loaded latency/jitter, CPU/DPC, throughput and loss.

- **Notas:** Microsoft documents latency-vs-CPU tradeoff.

- **Fontes:** [https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics)


### NET-BUFFERS — Receive/Transmit buffers

- **Categoria:** Network / NIC

- **Implementação:** Query exact driver properties and allowed range; set only after packet drops/throughput issue evidence. Do not set max blindly.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Driver default/auto

- **Benefício possível:** Increasing RX buffers can reduce drops in high traffic; may increase queuing/memory and not reduce gaming latency.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Official/conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** NIC driver exposes buffers.

- **Rollback:** Restore original numeric values.

- **Como validar:** Dropped packets, throughput, latency under load, memory.

- **Notas:** Gaming and server workloads differ.

- **Fontes:** [https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-server/networking/technologies/network-subsystem/net-sub-performance-tuning-nics)


### NET-EEE — Energy Efficient Ethernet / green Ethernet

- **Categoria:** Network / NIC

- **Implementação:** Inspect exact DisplayName/value for NIC; test disable only if link interruptions/latency spikes correlated with EEE.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Driver default; test off for reproducible issue

- **Benefício possível:** Can fix some device/router interoperability or wake spikes; usually little effect on steady-state ping.

- **Elegibilidade:** Ethernet NIC/router supports EEE.

- **Rollback:** Restore original value.

- **Como validar:** link events, ping jitter, power.

- **Notas:** Increases power; don't assume universal improvement.


### NET-JUMBO — Jumbo frames

- **Categoria:** Network / NIC

- **Implementação:** Only configure a private LAN end-to-end if all switches/NICs/hosts support same MTU. Never set jumbo for public Internet gaming generally.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Standard MTU for Internet gaming

- **Benefício possível:** Can improve throughput on large LAN transfers; not lower Internet ping.

- **Elegibilidade:** Entire LAN path validated.

- **Notas:** Do not recommend for online games.


### NET-WIFI-ADV — Wi-Fi adapter advanced properties

- **Categoria:** Network / Wi-Fi

- **Implementação:** Read properties/allowed values using driver enumeration; per adapter properties like roaming aggressiveness, preferred band, transmit power, power save depend exact driver. Never write values based only on English name if localized.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Driver defaults; prefer clean signal/channel

- **Benefício possível:** Can reduce roam/interference in specific environments, not fix ISP routes.

### NET-NAGLE — Nagle / TcpAckFrequency / TCPNoDelay registry hacks

- **Categoria:** Network / TCP

- **Implementação:** Do not offer universal one-click registry key tweak; these keys are app/adapter GUID dependent and often irrelevant to UDP game traffic. Add explanatory/advanced lab-only section.

### NET-NODELAY — TCPNoDelay app registry

- **Categoria:** Network / TCP

- **Implementação:** Lab-only; no automated global edit. Must map to exact app TCP/IP interface key and show key path/value change, signed app/game protocol evidence.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default

- **Benefício possível:** Could affect Nagle interaction for TCP only, irrelevant to UDP and may increase packets.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Application-specific | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Only with known app and test.

- **Rollback:** Snapshot exact key; restore prior presence/value.

- **Notas:** Don't invent app GUID or apply to all interfaces.


### NET-QOS — QoS / game traffic priority

- **Categoria:** Network / router

- **Implementação:** Use router SQM/QoS if congestion measured; Windows Policy-based QoS only if user knows DSCP/port and network honors it. Windows “reserved bandwidth” policy does not create ISP bandwidth.

- **Padrão recomendado:** No special priority when network not congested

- **Benefício possível:** Can reduce loaded latency when queue management is applied at bottleneck; host-only DSCP often ignored.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Router supports SQM/QoS; identify uplink/ISP cap.

- **Rollback:** Delete/disable created policy and restore router policy.

- **Como validar:** Latency under upload/download, jitter/loss, DSCP path if testable.

- **Notas:** Recommend CAKE/FQ-CoDel at router where supported, not magic windows tweak.


### NET-BUFFERBLOAT — Bufferbloat assessment/presets

- **Categoria:** Network / router

- **Implementação:** Run latency test idle vs saturated upload/download, record bandwidth; guide rate limit/SQM only on router at near bottleneck rates. Do not pretend Windows registry can fix router queue.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Diagnose before modifying; use router SQM if indicated

- **Benefício possível:** Potentially large improvement in loaded ping when bufferbloat is actual bottleneck.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** High conditional | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Router supports SQM/QoS or user can change it.

- **Rollback:** Restore router config backup/rate settings.

- **Como validar:** Idle vs loaded latency p95, jitter, throughput, packet loss.

- **Notas:** Separate local input latency from network RTT.


### NET-DNS — DNS resolver

- **Categoria:** Network / name resolution

- **Implementação:** Optionally set DNS via Windows network UI/Set-DnsClientServerAddress after recording original; no promise of lower in-game ping. DNS cache flush only for resolution errors.

- **Padrão recomendado:** ISP/router default unless lookup failure or slow name resolution

- **Benefício possível:** Can change connection setup/name resolution, not latency once game connected.

- **Risco:** Low-medium | **Evidência:** High for DNS behavior, low for gameplay latency | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Adapter/interface and IPv4/IPv6.

- **Rollback:** Restore saved DNS server addresses and DHCP mode.

- **Como validar:** DNS lookup duration and connectivity, not game FPS.

### NET-IPV6 — IPv6 transition/IPv6 disable

- **Categoria:** Network / IPv6

- **Implementação:** Keep IPv6 enabled by default; read interfaces/routes; only disable a specific transition mechanism if exact network problem and support documentation. Avoid disabling IPv6 globally.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Enabled/default

### NET-NEIGHBOR — Neighbor cache / weak host send/receive

- **Categoria:** Network / routing

- **Implementação:** Read-only `Get-NetNeighbor`, `Get-NetIPInterface`; change `WeakHostSend/Receive` only for multi-homed routing scenario, not gaming preset.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default strict host model

- **Benefício possível:** Only fixes specific multi-interface routing; gaming FPS/ping usually unaffected.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Special-case | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** VPN/multihomed routing diagnosed.

- **Rollback:** Restore original interface properties.

- **Como validar:** Route table, connection stability and packet trace.

- **Notas:** No generic optimize neighbor cache toggle.


### NET-UDP-FW — UDP firewall rules

- **Categoria:** Network / firewall

- **Implementação:** Keep Windows Firewall on; add a narrow, executable-scoped allow rule only when a blocked game is diagnosed. Do not disable firewall globally or broad UDP filtering.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Firewall enabled/default rules

- **Benefício possível:** May fix connectivity; no generic ping improvement.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Official security baseline | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Specific app/port/blocked event.

- **Rollback:** Remove the exact created rule; preserve prior policy.

- **Notas:** Never “disable security profiles”.


### NET-ROUTE — Network route stability

- **Categoria:** Network / route

- **Implementação:** Read `Get-NetRoute`, `Get-NetIPConfiguration`, `tracert/pathping` diagnostics; only change route if a known bad local route exists and user selects it.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Routes managed automatically

- **Benefício possível:** May fix explicit local routing fault; cannot force ISP external route.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Case-specific | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

### NET-WINSOCK — Winsock reset/buffers

### NET-PRIORITY — Game network priority

- **Categoria:** Network / QoS

- **Implementação:** Detect game protocol/ports optionally; guide per-app QoS and router SQM; never assume Process priority affects packets.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default

- **Benefício possível:** Only helps if actual contested bandwidth/queue; no physical ping reduction.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Network congestion measured.

### NET-ADAPTER-POWER — Adapter power management

- **Categoria:** Network / NIC

- **Implementação:** Device Manager > network adapter > Power Management; adjust per adapter only for disconnect/wake issue.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Padrão

- **Benefício possível:** May reduce disconnect or wake delays; no sustained gaming performance boost normally.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Notas:** Laptop battery warning.


### NET-QOS-RESERVED — Remove limits on QoS / bandwidth reservation

- **Categoria:** Network / policy

- **Implementação:** Do not change `NonBestEffortLimit` as general speed tweak; inspect actual policy and GPO. Explain reserved bandwidth isn't a fixed cap on all consumer traffic by default.

- **Padrão recomendado:** OS defaults/policy

- **Benefício possível:** No predictable increase in Internet throughput/FPS.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Low universal benefit | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Managed network/group policy.

- **Rollback:** Restore original GPO/policy value.

### TIMER-RES — Timer resolution

- **Categoria:** Windows / timer

- **Implementação:** If app uses a timer API, request resolution only while game profile active, release on exit (timeBeginPeriod/appropriate documented API); do not set global timer permanently and detect other processes.

- **Como validar:** ETW, power/CPU, input/frametime repeated A/B.

- **Notas:** Microsoft explains power cost of high-resolution timers.

- **Fontes:** [https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-hardware/drivers/kernel/high-resolution-timers](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-hardware/drivers/kernel/high-resolution-timers)


### TIMER-BCDEDIT — BCDEdit timer flags (useplatformtick/useplatformclock/disabledynamictick)

- **Categoria:** Boot / timers

- **Implementação:** Read `bcdedit /enum {current}`; do not change in one-click optimizer. Microsoft documents relevant options for debugging. If manual lab test requested, export BCD and give separate recovery procedure.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default/not set

- **Benefício possível:** No universal FPS/input-lag gain; can worsen timing/power/boot behavior.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Official debugging-only | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Admin and boot config.

- **Rollback:** Capture original BCD output; restore defaults only under controlled guide; recovery media recommended.

- **Como validar:** Latency + frametime+power across boots, with original boot config.

- **Notas:** Do not include in “recommended” quick optimize.

- **Fontes:** [https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-hardware/drivers/devtest/bcdedit--set](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-hardware/drivers/devtest/bcdedit--set)


### TIMER-HPET — HPET/platform clock

- **Categoria:** Windows / timer

- **Implementação:** Read hardware/BCD state only; do not switch device manager or BCD flags automatically.

- **Padrão recomendado:** System/platform default

- **Benefício possível:** No universal gain; forcing clock source is diagnostic only.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Official debugging context | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Platform/build-specific.

- **Rollback:** Restore prior setting with recovery plan.

- **Como validar:** Measured clock/latency, boot tests, power.

- **Notas:** Do not present “HPET off = lower latency” as fact.

- **Fontes:** [https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-hardware/drivers/devtest/bcdedit--set](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/windows-hardware/drivers/devtest/bcdedit--set)


### INPUT-POINTER — Enhance pointer precision / Windows pointer speed

- **Categoria:** Input / mouse

- **Implementação:** Expose UI deep link for Mouse Settings > Additional mouse settings > Pointer Options; optional toggle only with confirmation. Game Raw Input may bypass pointer accel.

- **Padrão recomendado:** For competitive mouse, user commonly prefers Enhance pointer precision off; only affects paths using Windows pointer accel

- **Benefício possível:** Improves consistent desktop/cursor movement; usually not applicable to raw-input games.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Official behavior, game-specific | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Mouse/game input mode.

- **Rollback:** Restore previous checkbox and speed.

- **Como validar:** In-game reproducibility/test aim; don't label as hardware latency reduction.

- **Notas:** Don't dictate DPI/sensitivity as a performance tweak.


### INPUT-POLLING — Mouse polling rate

- **Categoria:** Input / peripheral

- **Implementação:** Detect report rate only if vendor SDK; offer official mouse software link and supported values (125/250/500/1000/2000/4000/8000Hz etc as device supports); no USB registry hacks.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Vendor supported value; start 1000Hz and A/B higher rates

- **Benefício possível:** Higher polling can lower interval but raise CPU/USB load; high rates can worsen frame pacing on some systems.

- **Risco:** Low-medium | **Evidência:** Device-dependent | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Exact mouse, USB port, game, CPU.

- **Rollback:** Return to prior vendor profile/rate.

- **Como validar:** Measured report rate, CPU frametime, input measurement if available.

- **Notas:** No universal 8kHz recommendation.


### INPUT-USB-POWER — USB selective suspend / hub power

- **Categoria:** Input / USB

- **Implementação:** Detect device/hub; disable power saving only for implicated mouse/keyboard/hub in Device Manager when checkbox exists; don't blanket disable all hubs.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default; per-device troubleshoot only

- **Benefício possível:** Can fix disconnects/sleep problems; no FPS gain normally.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Reproducible disconnect/suspend problem.

- **Rollback:** Restore per-device checkbox/power profile exact.

- **Como validar:** Device events, polling stability and battery/power.

- **Notas:** Retain on battery unless required.


### INPUT-FIRMWARE — Mouse/keyboard firmware

- **Categoria:** Input / peripherals

- **Implementação:** Detect vendor/model; link official vendor firmware and warn not to update during unstable power; never flash from unverified package.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Current stable firmware only where release fixes issue

- **Benefício possível:** Can fix disconnect/polling bugs; not automatic latency improvement.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Exact model/vendor package.

- **Rollback:** Firmware often non-reversible; recovery instructions only.

- **Como validar:** Vendor release notes, polling, disconnect counts.

- **Notas:** No automatic flash.


### INPUT-KEYBOARD — Keyboard debounce / rapid trigger / actuation

- **Categoria:** Input / keyboard

- **Implementação:** Use vendor SDK/UI only; expose existing device-supported fields; do not invent registry keys. For Hall Effect use profile backup and min/max per device.

- **Padrão recomendado:** User choice + stable vendor defaults

- **Benefício possível:** May change actuation behavior; too sensitive causes false keypresses.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Device-dependent | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Supported keyboard and software.

- **Rollback:** Restore profile snapshot/default.

- **Como validar:** False activations, repeat test, game usability.

- **Notas:** Hardware feature, not OS-wide latency magic.


### AUDIO-POWER — Audio idle timer / always active

- **Categoria:** Audio / power

- **Implementação:** Use Windows Sound device settings and driver/vendor controls; avoid registry hacks if exact key varies. Test only if audio device wakes late/cuts out.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default; always-active only when device problem requires

- **Benefício possível:** May fix first-audio latency/cutout, not FPS; can increase power.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Specific audio endpoint/driver issue.

- **Rollback:** Restore original settings.

- **Como validar:** Audio glitch/latency, endpoint availability, CPU/DPC.

- **Notas:** Don't force all audio devices active globally.


### MSI-MODE — Message-Signaled Interrupts (MSI) device mode

- **Categoria:** Device / interrupts

- **Implementação:** Read PnP device, driver, hardware IDs and MSI support. Do not set MSISupported or IRQ priority for every device; only a documented device/driver-specific procedure and snapshot.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Driver default

- **Benefício possível:** Can help a specific interrupt/driver bottleneck, but no universal FPS gain; misconfiguration may BSOD/audio/network issues.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Device-specific | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Driver supports MSI; reliable source and exact hardware ID.

- **Rollback:** Restore exact registry/policy values; recovery instructions.

- **Como validar:** LatencyMon/ETW DPC/ISR, device function, crash reports, A/B.

- **Notas:** No global MSI Mode button.


### DRIVER-DPC — DPC/ISR latency diagnosis

- **Categoria:** Diagnostics / drivers

- **Implementação:** Use ETW/WPR/WPA or LatencyMon as a lead, not absolute proof; identify driver/module and trigger.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Read-only

- **Benefício possível:** Can find the actual driver causing stutters/audio/input spikes.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** High diagnostic value | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** ETW/driver tools available.

- **Rollback:** No changes until root cause.

- **Como validar:** DPC/ISR distribution, frametime correlation.

- **Notas:** Avoid “fixing” every reported driver blindly.


### SEC-HVCI — Memory Integrity / HVCI / VBS

- **Categoria:** Security / virtualization

- **Implementação:** Read Windows Security > Device Security and `Win32_DeviceGuard`; if offering off toggle, manual-only with explicit security impact, typed confirmation, reboot and rollback to on. Don't disable by default.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Keep enabled unless compatibility/performance test has concrete justification

- **Benefício possível:** Performance impact varies by CPU/OS; disabling lowers kernel protections and is not guaranteed to improve FPS.

- **Risco:** Critical | **Evidência:** Official security tradeoff | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Windows 10/11, compatible driver/hypervisor state.

- **Rollback:** Re-enable in Windows Security/GPO/Registry documented path; check current VBS status after reboot.

- **Como validar:** Game benchmark + security status + driver compatibility; restore on regression.

- **Notas:** Warn that security protections are reduced; no hidden opt-out.

- **Fontes:** [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/hardware-security/enable-virtualization-based-protection-of-code-integrity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/hardware-security/enable-virtualization-based-protection-of-code-integrity)


### SEC-DEFENDER — Microsoft Defender real-time protection

- **Categoria:** Security

- **Implementação:** Do not disable through optimizer. If user investigates performance, diagnose `MsMpEng.exe`/scan timing and use sanctioned scheduling or narrow game-folder exclusion only after risk explanation; broad exclusions blocked.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Protection enabled

- **Benefício possível:** Scheduled scans/background activity may coincide with load; disabling protection exposes PC and gives no guaranteed FPS.

- **Risco:** Critical | **Evidência:** Security risk; conditional diagnosis | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Defender status and scan logs.

- **Rollback:** Restore real-time protection; remove exclusions after test.

- **Como validar:** Measure scan event/CPU and game frametime, security status.

- **Notas:** No one-click Defender off or broad root exclusions.


### SEC-FIREWALL — Windows Firewall / Security Profiles

- **Categoria:** Security / network

- **Implementação:** Keep firewall enabled; troubleshoot specific blocked game using narrow executable/port rule. Never disable all firewall profiles.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Enabled

- **Benefício possível:** Fixes connectivity only for rule block; no general ping/FPS gain.

- **Risco:** Critical | **Evidência:** Official baseline | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Specific blocked app.

- **Rollback:** Remove exact exception and restore profile state.

- **Como validar:** Matchmaking/connectivity and firewall state.

- **Notas:** No global disable.


### SEC-DIAGNOSTIC-LOGS — Disable all auto loggers / diagnostics

- **Categoria:** Security / diagnostic

- **Implementação:** No all-purpose toggle. Enumerate exact diagnostic scheduled task or logger and whether it is consuming CPU/IO; retain system crash/event logs.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Keep logging needed for troubleshooting

- **Benefício possível:** No generic FPS gain; hiding telemetry can make root-cause diagnosis worse.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Weak performance evidence | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Exact logger identified.

- **Rollback:** Restore exact scheduled task/policy.

- **Como validar:** CPU/IO correlated with task and events.

- **Notas:** Never disable crash/error logging for gaming preset.


### SEC-DMA — DMA remapping / Kernel DMA protection

- **Categoria:** Security / device

- **Implementação:** Read status in Windows Security / system info; no auto-disable. The EXM label is ambiguous.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Enabled where supported

- **Benefício possível:** No proven FPS gain; weakens protections against DMA attacks.

- **Risco:** Critical | **Evidência:** Security feature | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Compatible hardware/OS.

- **Rollback:** Manual restore may require settings/policy/firmware.

- **Como validar:** Security state, device functionality.

- **Notas:** Status display only.


### SEC-WINDOWS-UPDATE — Windows Update services/tasks

- **Categoria:** Security / maintenance

- **Implementação:** Use active hours and temporary pause via Settings; don't disable Update medic/Scheduled tasks/services as a preset.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Enabled; schedule/active hours as needed

- **Benefício possível:** Avoid interruptions; disabling update service does not increase game performance and leaves vulnerabilities.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Low FPS claim | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Windows edition/organization policies.

- **Rollback:** Re-enable update/policies and resume updates.

- **Como validar:** Update compliance and no install during test.

- **Notas:** No “Disable Windows Updates” default.


### SEC-BOOT — Boot configuration integrity

- **Categoria:** Security / boot

- **Implementação:** Read BCD state, Secure Boot, VBS; no changes to test-signing, nointegritychecks, hypervisorlaunchtype or boot policies under optimization.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Secure boot and normal boot integrity defaults

- **Benefício possível:** No FPS claim; lowering boot protections increases risk.

- **Risco:** Critical | **Evidência:** Security baseline | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Hardware/OS support.

- **Rollback:** Requires recovery path if changed.

- **Como validar:** msinfo32, BCD and security health.

- **Notas:** Do not alter boot integrity flags.


### GAME-DETECT — Automatic/manual game detection

- **Categoria:** Game Mode

- **Implementação:** Allow executable selection and process tree preview; detect signed path and process creation. Do not rely on display name only.

- **Padrão recomendado:** User-selected games only

- **Benefício possível:** Triggers only the right temporary profile; no direct FPS gain.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Functional | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Game executable/process tree identified.

- **Rollback:** Remove profile or toggle off; event log of actions.

- **Como validar:** Detection accuracy and false positives.

- **Notas:** No automatic service changes until detection is confirmed.


### GAME-PROFILE — Per-game optimization profiles

- **Categoria:** Game Mode

- **Implementação:** Create named profiles from per-setting IDs; apply only supported settings for that game/hardware, one at a time.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default profile = no risky changes

- **Benefício possível:** Lets user A/B compare; prevents conflicting global settings.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Product architecture | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Game/driver/OS detected.

- **Rollback:** Restore full before-state snapshot per setting.

- **Como validar:** Automated benchmark and telemetry.

- **Notas:** Profiles must not write unverified EXM toggles.


### GAME-SERVICE-MODE — Temporary service process optimization

- **Categoria:** Game Mode

- **Implementação:** Whitelist with allowlisted service names only, previous state capture, session lock, watchdog; prefer set process priority to stop service only if safe.

- **Padrão recomendado:** No services stopped in default profile

- **Benefício possível:** May reduce background load if a proven service spikes; risk of audio/network/game failure.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Exact service purpose, dependencies and game; no anti-cheat/kernel/security services.

- **Rollback:** Restore state on game exit, crash, reboot startup recovery.

- **Como validar:** Service state, audio/network/game health and frametime.

- **Notas:** If rollback fails, revert automatically and stop applying profiles.


### GAME-STEAM — Steam optimization

- **Categoria:** Applications / Steam

- **Implementação:** Only manage Steam overlay, startup, downloads during play, shader pre-caching/user settings through supported UI; do not alter update system or delete cache blindly.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Keep core features; optional overlay/download scheduling

- **Benefício possível:** Potentially reduces background downloads/overlay overhead; no guaranteed FPS.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Steam installed and active.

- **Rollback:** Restore settings and allow downloads/update.

- **Como validar:** Network usage, disk I/O, frametime.

- **Notas:** Do not disable anti-cheat/runtime dependencies.


### TOOL-AFTERBURNER — MSI Afterburner / RTSS integration

- **Categoria:** Tools / telemetry

- **Implementação:** Integrate monitoring or launch official software; don't write GPU registers directly. Allow RTSS cap/OSD separately and account for OSD overhead.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Telemetry off unless needed; cap optional

- **Benefício possível:** Monitoring helps find bottleneck; OSD can add tiny overhead.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Tool specific | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Supported GPU and signed software.

- **Rollback:** Disable OSD/restore profile.

- **Como validar:** Compare with OSD on/off.

- **Notas:** Do not confuse MSI Afterburner with MSI Mode Utility.


### TOOL-ISLC — Standby list cleaner / ISLC-like function

- **Categoria:** Tools / memory

- **Implementação:** Do not auto-purge memory lists; if exposed, require measured hard-fault/standby symptom, show exactly what will be cleared and keep it off by default.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Disabled/default

- **Benefício possível:** May help a narrow OS/game memory-pressure issue; can worsen cold loads/stutters.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Weak/conditional | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Reproducible memory issue and exact supported OS.

- **Rollback:** No clean reversal for discarded cache; restart/warm caches.

- **Como validar:** Hard faults/frametime before/after 3+ runs.

- **Notas:** Do not ship as routine cleaner.


### TOOL-DDU — Driver cleanup utility

- **Categoria:** Tools / GPU driver

- **Implementação:** Offer only as advanced troubleshooting workflow: create restore point, download known-good official driver, disconnect internet if installer conflict, use safe mode by user choice; never automatic routine.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Normal official update; DDU only if conflict/corruption

- **Benefício possível:** Can fix broken driver remnants; doesn't create FPS on healthy setup.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Troubleshooting only | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Persistent driver issue/failed install.

- **Rollback:** Reinstall known-good driver; Windows recovery plan.

- **Como validar:** Driver integrity, device status, benchmark.

- **Notas:** No use DDU for every update.


### TOOL-NVCLEANSTALL — Customized/debloated NVIDIA driver install

- **Categoria:** Tools / driver

- **Implementação:** Prefer NVIDIA official installer/custom installation. If third-party component selector offered, show exact components and lost features; require user download/official signature verification.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Official full driver baseline; components optional

- **Benefício possível:** May reduce background components; FPS gains not guaranteed; functionality may be lost.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** NVIDIA GPU/compatible driver signing.

- **Rollback:** Reinstall official package and restore app/HD audio/overlay components.

- **Como validar:** Process count, functionality, same-game benchmark.

- **Notas:** Don't distribute modified driver binaries.


### TOOL-MEASURE — FPS/frametime benchmark

- **Categoria:** Diagnostics / performance

- **Implementação:** Use PresentMon/CapFrameX compatible capture, same test scene; store raw traces. Record average, 1% low, 0.1% low, median/p95/p99 frametime; mark generated frames separately.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Required baseline before tuning

- **Benefício possível:** Provides evidence rather than assumed gain.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** High methodology | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Supported game capture/privileges.

- **Rollback:** No system changes.

- **Como validar:** At least 3 runs per variant; median and confidence interval/variance.

- **Notas:** Do not infer 1% low from one run.


### TOOL-LATENCY — Input/system/network latency measurement

- **Categoria:** Diagnostics / latency

- **Implementação:** Use game Reflex Latency Analyzer/LDAT if available; otherwise state limitations and use relative repeated measures. Separate input-to-photon from ping and timer resolution.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Measure before claiming a result

- **Benefício possível:** Prevents conflating local input lag, frame time and network RTT.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** High methodology | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Available sensors/endpoint/game.

- **Rollback:** No changes.

- **Como validar:** Repeat controlled test; report uncertainty.

- **Notas:** Never fabricate absolute input-latency values.


### TOOL-RESTORE — Per-tweak backup and rollback engine

- **Categoria:** Product reliability

- **Implementação:** Before every action capture original value, provenance (UI/registry/service/power/device), exact OS build, timestamp, command exit/stdout; transactional apply + readback; reverse in reverse order.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Required for all system changes

- **Benefício possível:** Prevents persistent damage and supports trusted experimentation.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Engineering requirement | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Admin permission only when necessary.

- **Rollback:** Automated exact rollback, reboot-required status and rescue mode.

- **Como validar:** Unit tests with mock state; post-apply readback.

- **Notas:** Restore point alone is insufficient.


### TOOL-ELIGIBILITY — Compatibility detection rules

- **Categoria:** Product architecture

- **Implementação:** Detect Windows edition/build, admin, device IDs, driver provider/version, GPU brand, laptop/desktop, AC/battery, game API, NIC property values and policy conflicts. Unsupported = hide/disable setting.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Required, fail closed

- **Benefício possível:** Prevents invalid values and bad tuning.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Engineering requirement | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** CIM/SetupAPI/driver properties.

- **Rollback:** No changes; user can refresh detection.

- **Como validar:** Unit tests with diverse hardware profiles.

- **Notas:** Never assume all 153 tweaks exist on all machines.


### TOOL-EVIDENCE — Evidence and effectiveness rating

- **Categoria:** Product architecture

- **Implementação:** For each setting store official source, last verified date, build/driver range, confidence, benchmark data by hardware/game; labels “documented/conditional/unsupported”.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Required

- **Benefício possível:** Stops placebo marketing and helps select useful options.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Engineering requirement | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Curated vendor sources/test harness.

- **Rollback:** No changes.

- **Como validar:** Audit source link and benchmark cohort.

- **Notas:** Do not infer causality from one benchmark run.


### TOOL-SECURITY — Risk gates and consent

- **Categoria:** Product architecture

- **Implementação:** Risk enum + explicit dialog; high/critical requires typed phrase, admin check, backup, restore and possibly reboot; critical safety features remain blocked by default.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Required

- **Benefício possível:** Avoids accidental security/hardware disable.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Engineering requirement | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Settings have actual risk + rollback.

- **Rollback:** Cancel by default; rollback path visible.

- **Como validar:** UX/accessibility audit and negative tests.

- **Notas:** User asks for high-risk options; provide disclosure, not silent apply.


### WIN-VRR — Windows Variable Refresh Rate / monitor refresh

- **Categoria:** Display / latency

- **Implementação:** Read current mode using DisplayConfig APIs; UI deep-link to Advanced Display; set max refresh only by user/UI if supported. VRR setting per app where available.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Select maximum supported refresh; VRR per preference

- **Benefício possível:** Higher refresh reduces display interval; VRR can reduce tearing/stutter; not equivalent to higher rendered FPS.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Official/conditional | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Monitor/GPU/cable/mode supports it.

- **Rollback:** Restore previous display mode/VRR setting.

- **Como validar:** Monitor refresh confirmation, frame pacing and tearing.

- **Notas:** Must detect monitor support and HDR/VRR conflict.


### WIN-HDR — HDR/Auto HDR

- **Categoria:** Display / rendering

- **Implementação:** UI per display/app. Do not alter registry without support; test only if user uses HDR/Auto HDR or compatibility issue.

- **Padrão recomendado:** User choice

- **Benefício possível:** Primarily image quality; may increase GPU cost in some cases; no universal FPS gain.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** HDR display / game.

- **Rollback:** Restore toggle and calibration.

- **Como validar:** GPU load, color output, game performance.

- **Notas:** Separate color/visual preference from performance.


### WIN-POWERTHROTTLE — Windows Power Throttling

- **Categoria:** Windows / power

- **Implementação:** Observe process power throttling via documented APIs/UI/policy; don't globally set undocumented PowerThrottlingOff registry key. If background app throttled incorrectly, diagnose per process.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Windows default

- **Benefício possível:** Global disable increases idle power and may not increase game FPS.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Weak universal performance evidence | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Windows version/process policy.

- **Rollback:** Restore exact policy/registry snapshot if vendor-documented change made.

- **Como validar:** CPU clocks and power under same load.

- **Notas:** No global PowerThrottlingOff preset.


### WIN-DELIVERY — Delivery Optimization / background downloads

- **Categoria:** Windows / network

- **Implementação:** Use Settings > Windows Update > Advanced options > Delivery Optimization and bandwidth limits; don't disable all update services.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Limit/disable peer-to-peer if unwanted; leave updates working

- **Benefício possível:** Can reduce network competition during downloads; no local FPS gain if no activity.

- **Risco:** Low | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `safe`

- **Elegibilidade:** Windows Update activity measured.

- **Rollback:** Restore bandwidth/peer settings.

- **Como validar:** Loaded RTT and NIC throughput during update.

- **Notas:** Prioritize scheduling over disabling service.


### WIN-PREFETCH — Prefetch/SysMain

- **Categoria:** Windows / storage

- **Implementação:** Keep SysMain/default; disable only if identified as source of reproducible HDD thrash on a particular system. Don't delete Prefetch folder.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default

- **Benefício possível:** May help a subset of HDD issues; can hurt app load behavior on SSD too.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Specific I/O diagnosis and drive type.

- **Rollback:** Restore service startup/running state.

- **Como validar:** Disk queue, hard faults, application load, frametime.

- **Notas:** No blanket disable.


### WIN-MMCSS — MMCSS/SystemResponsiveness

- **Categoria:** Windows / multimedia scheduling

- **Implementação:** Read current configuration. Do not set `SystemResponsiveness=0` as universal tweak; Windows clamps/uses documented semantics and MMCSS is important to multimedia tasks.

- **Padrão recomendado:** Default

- **Benefício possível:** No reliable general FPS gain from arbitrary value; risk audio/multimedia scheduling.

- **Risco:** High | **Evidência:** Official context-dependent | **Modo:** `blocked`

- **Elegibilidade:** Exact Windows build/MMCSS tasks.

- **Rollback:** Export original key and restore exact value/presence.

- **Como validar:** Audio DPC, frame time, app responsiveness.

- **Notas:** No unverified registry preset.


### WIN-DVR-GPO — Game recording/broadcasting Group Policy

- **Categoria:** Windows / policy

- **Implementação:** Only apply policy when edition exposes it and user expressly wants recording blocked; record current GPO and registry-backed policy source.

- **Padrão recomendado:** No policy override if user uses capture

- **Benefício possível:** Can prevent background capture; effect depends on capture actually active.

- **Risco:** Medium | **Evidência:** Conditional | **Modo:** `manual_confirmation`

- **Elegibilidade:** Windows editions/policy paths.

- **Rollback:** Restore prior GPO and refresh policy.

Os IDs abaixo conectam cada item da lista anterior aos controles concretos da biblioteca. Categorias genéricas devem abrir uma coleção de ajustes, não virar um botão único.


### 1. System Optimization / Windows Optimization

Ajustes gerais de políticas e configurações do Windows. Pode reduzir atividade dispensável, mas não cria potência de CPU/GPU; avalie cada alteração separadamente.

**Controles relacionados:** `WIN-GAMEMODE` (Windows Game Mode), `WIN-CAPTURE` (Game DVR / captura em segundo plano), `WIN-OVERLAY` (Overlays de jogos e apps), `WIN-STARTUP` (Aplicativos de inicialização), `WIN-APPBG` (Atividade em segundo plano), `WIN-TRANSPARENCY` (Transparency Effects), `WIN-ANIMATION` (Animações/efeitos visuais), `WIN-NOTIFICATIONS` (Notificações/Focus Assist), `WIN-UPDATE-WINDOW` (Agendar Windows Update/horários ativos).
